patch.summary: ManyChat cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ManyChat pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: ManyChat cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ManyChat against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (sms messaging (Free, Essential, Pro, Business, Advanced)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (WhatsApp Business, shared inbox, CRM CTI) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Marketing chatbot posture — thinner support-desk / omnichannel agent ops than respond.io. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Creators and ecommerce brands automating Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp DMs requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
